source_text: This 2012 policy, reaffirmed in subsequent reviews, cites reductions in urinary tract infections (UTIs) in infancy (from 1% to 0.1-0.2% risk), certain sexually transmitted infections (STIs) including HIV (approximately 50-60% relative reduction in heterosexual acquisition), and rare conditions like penile cancer. [156] [130]
